templates.name: ieeg_processed_timeseries
templates.summary: voltage trace for one channel, or a bipolar montage of two channels, of an intracranial iEEG recording in EDF or NWB (NWB as written by the MEF converter), over a chosen time window, with optional DSP processing; "plot channel LA01 from 10s to 15s", "show the LA01-LA02 montage for the first minute"

args.name: channel2
args.description: second channel; when given, the trace is the bipolar montage channel-channel2 (e.g. "LA01"-"LA02"). Both channels must share a sampling rate

args.name: start_time
args.description: window start: a number (in `time_unit`, from the recording start), a wall-clock "HH:MM:SS" on the recording's start day, or a full "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" for multi-day recordings; clock and date values are read on the recording's own clock

args.name: end_time
args.description: window end, in the same forms as start_time; provide EXACTLY ONE of end_time / duration

args.name: duration
args.description: window length in `time_unit`; provide EXACTLY ONE of end_time / duration

args.name: time_unit
args.description: unit for NUMERIC start/end/duration values (us, ms, s, min, h). REQUIRED whenever any of those is a plain number; omit only when all times are clock or date strings

args.name: y_range
args.description: y-axis extent: a single positive number N for a symmetric [-N, +N], or an explicit [min, max] pair; omit to auto-scale the y-axis to the data. Recommended for raw voltage traces (EEG is conventionally read at a fixed scale); ignored when the pipeline moves the y-axis off voltage (e.g. fft, psd, energy)

args.name: y_unit
args.description: voltage unit the y-axis / y_range are displayed in (V, mV, uV, nV); omit to use the unit the file itself declares for the channel

args.name: modality
args.description: what the recording is: "ieeg" (intracranial) or "eeg" (scalp). Omit to detect it from the channel names; pass it when the detection is wrong or the dataset says (BIDS). This template draws ieeg

templates.notes: There are NO silent defaults for the data selection: a missing channel, time, or time_unit (for numeric times) makes the canned render fail (it then falls back to the agent). y_range and y_unit are display settings with truthful defaults: omitted y_range auto-scales the y-axis, and omitted y_unit displays in the unit the file itself declares. The window may not exceed 600 s.
